kind: motion fix on g0.0c (the original page's own snap); no timing measured, by design

config.chrome: headless Chrome via tools/lib/cdp.mjs, 430x775 and 430x815 DPR3 mobile+touch, 768x1024 DPR2, 1280x800 DPR1; settable clock (performance.now, rAF timestamp), Date frozen
config.simulator: fw-sim iPhone 15 Pro Max, iOS 26.5, 430x775 at 3x, functional sim.mjs session
config.lane: shared chrome-measure lane, weight probe / simulator; no timing
config.tools: fixes/logo-close/probe/*.mjs (new), fixes/g0-revert/gates/g0px.mjs, g0sim.mjs, g0count.mjs (unchanged); no measurement code changed

verdict: The logo's one-frame snap at the end of the close (and the start of the open) at width <= 640 goes: close flip jump -15.36 px -> -0.13 px, the 120 Hz flip frame -15.38 -> -0.15 px against 0.07-0.09 px for its neighbours (Chrome 430x775/815 and Simulator alike); v0 = g0.0c (the original has the snap); 768/1280 and reduced motion unchanged; outside the logo's band T0 up to the load-to-load floor; Simulator counts within g0.0c's run-to-run range

cause.what: scale .75 with transform-origin 0 at rest, transform-origin 50% while .is-morphing (m > 0.001); the class flip moves the scaled logo by 0.125 x its width
cause.status: CONFIRMED: CSS Transforms 2 'current transformation matrix' (scale applied around transform-origin), https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transforms-2/#ctm; Chrome and WebKit agree to 0.01 px
cause.history: v14 had the fix (nav-earn rev 1, fixes/nav-earn/README.md 218-229); g0.0 reverted it with v14's end CSS (research/gpu-original/README.md 2.1)

path.chrome-430x815: same values as 430x775 for v0, g0.0c and the fix
path.chrome-430x775-reduce: g0.0c and fix identical: the logo jumps 32.00 <-> 169.25 px with the morph, no in-between frames

pixels.method: g0px.mjs / g0sim.mjs end phase (33-51 stops), split by probe/outside-logo.mjs into the logo's band (css y 25-56, x 0-300) and the rest, kept-v14 masks left out

pixels.chrome-768x1024: rule does not apply (<= 640 block): an A/A by construction; panel max 1-4, #platform cycler up to 251 (F-336), nav noise max 21-61 at 3 stops
